# JA4 attribution

Foxreq's JA4 TLS diagnostic implements the public JA4 algorithm described by
FoxIO, Inc. It was validated against the official Python README example from:

<https://github.com/FoxIO-LLC/ja4>

Reference revision: `f7bf03a` (accessed 2026-07-15).

JA4 TLS fingerprinting is published under the BSD 3-Clause license. JA4 and
JA4+ are trademarks of FoxIO, Inc. This project implements only the JA4 TLS
diagnostic; it does not incorporate the separately licensed JA4+ methods.
